entries.001fa391d322ae74: This business undertakes contracts for the construction of wood-frame detached houses and general wood-frame buildings, as well as construction works contracts. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended May 2026 was ¥5,588 million. It is also pursuing orders for large wooden facilities.
entries.06c201de911c6f35: C.S. Home constructs general wood-frame buildings, and Sanyo Kensetsu undertakes construction works contracts. It also handles large wooden facilities such as childcare facilities and apartment buildings.
entries.1cd48f4d3b52fc18: Manufacture and sale of panels for two-by-four construction
entries.268422a8600d1823: Centered on the special wards of Tokyo, it leases childcare facilities in cooperation with local governments and operators. In April 2026, it newly opened 2 childcare facilities.
entries.3696b3bf05059f42: The company and its consolidated subsidiaries Nanohana Housing, C.S. Home and Sanyo Kensetsu undertake the construction of wood-frame detached houses.
entries.3e0c93076fd2c819: The company manufactures and sells wall, floor, ceiling and roof panels used in two-by-four construction.
entries.46da4cea0977803d: This business leases and manages commercial and residential real estate. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended May 2026 was ¥1,343 million. Childcare facilities are the main leased properties, and in the fiscal year ended May 2026 the company earned rental income from 23 childcare facility properties and 43 other leased facilities.
entries.582ed71da1554661: Leasing and management of commercial and residential real estate
entries.5cdfda1b8dbe86c0: This is the group's core business, which pre-cuts timber used in conventional (wood-frame post-and-beam) construction and two-by-four construction at factories and sells it together with panels manufactured for two-by-four construction. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended May 2026 was ¥13,242 million. The company is also promoting a "materials and construction combined" approach that pairs supply of materials with erection work.
entries.662f30db7cfc14fc: Consolidated subsidiary C.S. Logistics is responsible for delivering pre-cut products.
entries.6f93c0b47c2c1475: The company and consolidated subsidiaries, including C.S. Real Estate Lease, lease and manage commercial and residential real estate. To stabilize its earnings base, it is advancing the acquisition of rental properties.
entries.737b6a39d9c6f5cb: This business is not included in reportable segments and develops and sells detached houses. Consolidated subsidiary C.S. Real Estate handles this business, and revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended May 2026 was ¥207 million.
entries.8f172e2e82a94aa2: Contracting of general wood-frame buildings and construction works
entries.9a43d82ec5a42688: Consolidated subsidiary C.S. Build undertakes framing work, assembling a building's main structural members on site, from installing the sills to erecting the columns, beams and roof frame.
entries.bfd094bd2e27745a: Real estate companies and local builders
entries.d0be16a248677510: The company and its consolidated subsidiary C.S. Material sawmill lumber and pre-cut it for conventional and two-by-four construction methods, and sell it. The Togane Plant and Sanbu Plant are the processing sites.
entries.dffd912205dc6924: A company that centers on precut processing of lumber for wooden houses, and also handles construction contracting for wooden houses and real estate leasing.
